name: fix_tokio_blocking_sleep
description: Replaces a blocking sleep inside async tasks with tokio::time::sleep
prompts: fetch_all in src/lib.rs spawns n tokio tasks that are supposed to run concurrently, but each one calls std::thread::sleep - which BLOCKS the runtime's worker thread instead of yielding, so on a small worker pool the tasks largely serialize (8 tasks x 100ms take ~400ms on 2 workers instead of ~100ms). Fix src/lib.rs to use tokio::time::sleep(...).await so the tasks genuinely overlap. Results stay in task order: index i yields i*2.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "conc_case"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
